conf_path.description: Path to the ceph.conf configuration file. Overrides the default search path.

mons.description: List of monitor addresses in monhost[:port] format. If empty, defaults to standard local monitor.

rbd_mirror_id.description: The ID portion of the daemon name (e.g., if name is client.rbd-mirror, id is empty or specific suffix). Empty string uses default name.

rbd_mirror_name.description: The rados user name to authenticate as.

cluster_name.description: The name of the Ceph cluster.

foreground_stderr.description: Run daemon in foreground and log to stderr instead of daemonizing and logging to syslog.

foreground_syslog.description: Run daemon in foreground and log to the usual syslog location instead of daemonizing.
